The eyeball verdict the numbers back up: at 400px every page reads clean and well-paced. At 3440px `/notes/` and its three children hold plain text to a ~720px reading column with 55-65% of the screen left totally blank — no rail, no exhibit, nothing (worst case pictured below). The two blog posts with a floating exhibit look fine *beside* the exhibit, but any paragraph with no exhibit next to it leaves a measured 2023px (59% of 3440) blank strip — exact numbers in the task log.

Fixed nothing, per brief. Left for the judge: the `.sidebar-link` strip findings and the inline-prose-link padding-thin findings may be intentional UX (full-width nav click targets, plain text links) rather than defects — flagged, not called wrong.
